questions.question: What should you do when you see a railroad crossing warning sign?

options.text: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Find a way around any lowered gates.
Assume no trains are nearby and keep driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossing warning signs tell you a train may be coming. Always obey these signs. Never go around barriers or ignore the warning.

questions.question: You must stop your vehicle in which situations?

options.text: When a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop at stop signs, at red lights, and whenever a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on your phone.

questions.explanation: Drivers must focus on the road. Any extra task while driving is dangerous and distracts you from driving safely.

questions.question: How does alcohol affect your driving skills and judgment?

options.text: It improves driving skills but damages judgment.
It damages both driving skills and judgment.
It does not affect driving skills or judgment.
It does not affect judgment but damages driving skills.

questions.correctAnswerText: It damages both driving skills and judgment.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time and makes it harder to see clearly. It also affects your ability to judge speed and distance, lowers your caution, and makes you more likely to take risks.

questions.question: What should you do when you approach a steady green traffic light?

options.text: Keep driving unless vehicles or pedestrians are already in the intersection.
Stop if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a four-way stop.
Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving unless vehicles or pedestrians are already in the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a green light, let pedestrians and vehicles already in the intersection go first. You can continue, but slow down in case the light changes before you reach it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is moving in both directions ahead.

questions.question: What should you do if a police officer stops you?

options.text: Unbuckle your seat belt and lower your window.
Get your paperwork ready before the officer reaches your car.
Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
Get out of your car and walk toward the patrol car.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car with your hands on the steering wheel and wait for the officer.
questions.explanation: Keep your hands on the wheel and make sure passengers keep their hands visible. Stay in your car unless the officer tells you to get out. Wait for the officer to ask for your license, registration, and insurance.

questions.question: What should you do if you are in a serious car crash?
questions.explanation: Move your car off the road and stop. If anyone is hurt, call 911. You must report the crash to police if someone is injured, if someone dies, or if damage is over $1,000.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a steep downhill section ahead.

questions.question: In what ways can alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects your brain's judgment and self-control. You may feel overly confident. It also slows your reaction time, harms coordination and balance, and makes it hard to judge distance and see clearly.

questions.question: If your car breaks down on a highway, what should you do?

options.text: Stay in your car and wait for help.
Turn on your four-way flashers to warn other drivers.
Honk your horn at passing cars.
Flash your headlights at oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your four-way flashers to warn other drivers.
questions.explanation: Turn on your hazard flashers right away. Move your car as far off the road as possible. Raise your hood so other drivers know your car is broken down.

questions.question: If you miss your freeway exit, what should you do?

options.text: Make a U-turn across the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up to your exit.
Get a police officer to help you back to your exit.

questions.explanation: Always go to the next exit. Never stop, back up, or cross the median on a highway. These actions are illegal and very dangerous.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Using safe driving methods to prevent crashes.
Driving in a way that is more dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: Using safe driving methods to prevent crashes.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means using safe techniques to avoid crashes. You adjust your driving based on weather, how you feel, and what other drivers, cyclists, and pedestrians are doing.

questions.question: What happens when you drink alcohol while taking prescription or over-the-counter medicine?

options.text: The medicine reduces how much the alcohol affects you.
The alcohol helps the medicine work better.
The two combined can greatly increase the effects of both.
They have no effect on each other because they are different.

questions.correctAnswerText: The two combined can greatly increase the effects of both.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with medicine makes both drugs more powerful. For example, one drink taken with a cold medicine could affect you as much as several drinks would normally.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, what should you do?

options.text: Stop your car at or near the accident scene.
Do not stand or walk in traffic lanes.
Turn off the engines of damaged vehicles.

questions.explanation: Stop at or near the accident scene. Move your car out of traffic if you can. Stay out of traffic lanes so other cars do not hit you. Turn off the engines of any damaged vehicles.

questions.question: You see a driver ahead using one hand and talking to a passenger. What should you do?

options.text: Keep extra distance from that vehicle.
Understand that the driver is not paying full attention and is less safe.
Do not drive the same way.

questions.explanation: Never get distracted by passengers, looking for things, reading, or daydreaming while driving. If another driver seems distracted, give them extra space because they are more likely to crash.

questions.question: Is smoking while driving a distraction?

options.text: No, it does not affect your driving.
No, it helps you stay alert.
Yes, it is a distracting activity.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, it is a distracting activity.
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road, creating a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: How much road space are motorcycles entitled to?

options.text: A full lane, the same as other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: A full lane, the same as other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use a full lane width, just like all other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are bumps in the road.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the divided highway will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Come to a complete stop and let others go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let others pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What helps a person recover from drinking alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time allows the body to get over the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: When you see a flashing yellow light, you should:
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light warns of danger ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Tiredness while driving is as dangerous as drunk driving. Stop driving if you feel tired.

questions.question: You should always use your turn signal when:

options.text: Pulling into or out of a parking space.
Pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area.

questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, pulling into or out of a parking space, or pulling into traffic from an alley or parking area. This tells other drivers what you plan to do and helps prevent accidents.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Ignore how many tracks there are to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: On long drives, you can avoid getting drowsy by:

options.text: Moving your eyes side to side while driving.

questions.explanation: Stop regularly on long trips to rest and stretch your body, even if you do not feel tired yet.

questions.question: You are angry after something that happened at work. When you get in your car, you should:

options.text: Play loud music so you will not think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Stop for drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, calm down before driving. Driving while angry is dangerous and puts you and others at risk.

questions.question: A driver who goes much slower than the speed limit:
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic can be hazardous. If traffic is backing up behind you, pull off the road to let other vehicles pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers turning left on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, they must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: How far your car travels before stopping is affected by:

options.text: The condition of your brakes and tires.

questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on your speed, the condition of your brakes and tires, and the condition of the road.
